segments.text_en: A city gets into contact with heaven (gods)
evidence: Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large me
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu
The flood, did it not twinkle? Frightening all
The heart of Enlil, it is the river Tigris, did it not bring sweet water?

segments.text_en: AT night Gudea gets an order to build a house
evidence: To the house its king spoke
to build the shiny house it raised its neck towards him
It was then, in a ‘dark goat’, that towards his king
Build his house!, he ordered him

segments.text_en: Gudea is seeking for help in interpretation
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant
may she stand by me in this case
its ‘heart’ I did not know
My dream-interpreter, knowing ‘ku3’ on her own
may she make its meaning visible for me

segments.text_en: Gudea travels to another city to make offerings and respond to Ningirsu
evidence: he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
he went to the king of Bagara, and prayed to him
Ningirsu, let me build your house for you
hero in her own right, lady-dream-interpreter of the gods
may she place the path for me

segments.text_en: Gudea provides a festival and sleep at the temple to please goddess and get help in the interpretation issue
evidence: In the House of Bagara he celebrated the week-festival
The governor set up his bed in the house of Gatumdu
You have placed my semen in the inside: you bore me in the cella
I will go to the city, may my sign be good
Let me, let me tell it to her
may she make its meaning visible for me

segments.text_en: Description of a dream with several gods, plan of the house and a brick, mold for a future
evidence: His cry was heard.
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
You are the dream interpreter of the gods
He spoke to me about the building of his house
His heart I did not understand
There was one woman. Who was it, who was it not?
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me
A donkey stallion, on the right side of my king, scratched the earth for me

segments.text_en: Nanse gives explanation about the dream
evidence: My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you
it is surely my brother Ningirsu
Build his shrine, the Eninnu! He ordered you
About the shiny star of the building of the house
it is Nindubba, placing the house on the plan of the house
in order not to let sweet sleep come to your eyes, (so) that the house is build
that is you, scratching the ground for Eninnu like a ‘choice’ (?) (donkey-)span

segments.text_en: Instructions that should help Gudea to prepare for building process
evidence: Let me give you instructions, let my instructions be heeded
after you broke the seal of your treasure house, after your brought out wood
he will receive your small word, as if it was a mighty word
He will reveal the plan of his house to you
The hero, his me are the greatest, he shall let it grow for you.

segments.text_en: Perfomance of instructions: knowledge gives an applied result
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea learnt big, and now he will perform big
To the word Nanše spoke to him, he bowed his head
He made the top of the mes wood good
He made it straight for him, for the lapis chariot
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it
in Eninnu, the white Anzu, he enters

segments.text_en: A ritual with sacrifice of animals and trees to undertake fear of terrifying place
evidence: Joyfully he entered to him in the house
For the second (time), in(?) the house he passed the days, he passed the nights
He flattened the hills, he returned accusations
To Šugalam, the terrible place, the place of rendering justice
cedar incense, the incense of the gods, its smoke he made

segments.text_en: GUdea is seeking for a clearer instructions about starting the construction (get it during dreams)
evidence: He rose for his king in public, he prayed to him
I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not
Hero you poured out the voice to me about the old order
I don’t understand its heart
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, heart
I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Enumeration of power related attributes of Ningirsu, mostly contain fear and overpowering others
evidence: its (me) is bigger than all the other enormous (me)
I, the lord, have made my house, the Eninnu, bigger than a mountain
my terrible eye, which the lands cannot sustain
I collected the fifty (me)
he perfected for me greatly the very large (me), my heavenly festival
when my (heart) has become angry with it, it produces poison for me like a poisonous snake
the great gods of Lagash, assemble for me

segments.text_en: Promises of abundance when the building will be start, after the process will be held, the meaning of the sign will be revealed
evidence: when your righteous hand caries it out
I will let bounty come to you from the heaven
May people stretch out the hand in bounty with you
may abundance arrive
Mounds that are never submerged, will be submerged for you
will weigh out wool in excess for you
when you put your righteous hand to my house, will straighten a wind for you
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign.

segments.text_en: Bring a dream to life, cleaning a city from impured people, restricting the accusations and providing sacred fire
evidence: He is afraid, it was a dream
The governor, in his city, like a solitary man he regulated the rites
He pruned, he returned accusations
He returned (sin) to its house
The slave girl, who a man wickedly made into booty, her lady did not thrown stuff in her face
An impure, a terrible one, a leper, he brought out from the city
The Anunna of area-Lagash, with Gudea in offering and prayer, they stood with him

segments.text_en: Gudea arranges levy on all cities to raise materials for construction
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land
in the totality of all of his lands
he placed a levy
The sun-disk, it is the emblem of Inanna, went at its head

segments.text_en: Lands are paying their levies by bringing valuable materials for the contruction of a temple
evidence: Elam came to him from Elam
For the construction of Ningirsu’s house, they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu
Its copper, like bringing much grain, he shall approach it to him
large oaks, ebony, mangrove-wood
He will build Eninnu with precious stones, sitting with the stonecutter
For the man, building his kings house

segments.text_en: Measuring procedure of a field for construction, borders were known by Gudea
evidence: He made the days long for him
he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight
he does not set his head to sleep during midday
It is him, the governor chosen in the heart by Enlil
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him
the field was right, he measured it
The day passed, he bathed
He fixated himself
The cultic order emerged

segments.text_en: Brick from the mold becomes a foundation for the temple, concerns and happiness both are presented
evidence: The emergence of the brick of the house was placed
He shook the mold, he threw the brick to dry
On its firing he looked righteously
incense, apples, and resin he smeared on its top
Utu was pleased with it
King Enki decided its destiny for him
He raised the brick, he brought it to his people
he does not allow sweet sleep to enter his eyes

segments.text_en: Retelling the whole process of the emergence of the building idea, but in a positive way
evidence: It was placed like something joyful for him
the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, was brought to his attention
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house?
He build the house, he planted the tree
The house raised the head to heaven like a mountain in heaven and earth

segments.text_en: Decoration of the temple with fruits and precious materials to make special scent and visuality
evidence: They placed white cedar to be admired
They cared for it with good resin and fine butter oil
The governor built the house, he made it grow
he counseled with him there
He planted sweet Asal trees in his city
he brought them in a single year
on the seventh day he seized them in the house
its name until the middle of the mountain he made emerge

segments.text_en: Final decorations for the temple and providing with food
evidence: Gudea made Ningirsu’s house made it stand to be admired
he made shine the horns
it is the terror of the x-heaven
it is the shiny mes tree of Abzu (competing) with innumerable mountains
He built, and after he had finished it

segments.text_en: Gudea puts some emblems of dead heroes and important signs
evidence: Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there
the seven heroes he seizes there
the emblem of Utu, the head of a bison, he places there
Because they are dead warriors, their names, in the midst of the gods,
made them emerge

segments.text_en: Description of abundance of the temple, but laso cautions against coming close to it
evidence: it is a young lioness, whose young ones rest on its paws
it is a dragon laying hand on a man
it is the shiny water snake of Abzu
the lonely wanderer cannot pass
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands

segments.text_en: Deliveries of food and precious materials
evidence: From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries
From the mighty oven, large cakes, large croissants
In the treasury, precious stones, silver, tin
The garden of the black plain placed with the house

segments.text_en: Final note about the temple - everyone should feel fear and praise it
evidence: The fear of Eninnu covers all the lands like a garment
The house (was) built in joy by its king.
built it on a big place
Temple--going out in the land, clad in joy
